time_to_mvp.note: A first upload is days away; a monetizable channel is not (estimate).

sales_cycle.note: No ad dollar until 1,000 subs + 8,000 watch hours (new rule from 2027-02-01): 12+ months.

channel_readiness.note: YouTube is the channel but the user has no audience; 59% of channels never pass 1,000 subs.

search_demand.note: History is mass-market on YouTube; AI sleep-history videos draw large bedtime audiences.

trend.note: No 5-year trend data pulled; viewing looks stable, supply is exploding (estimate).

willingness_to_pay.note: Viewers pay nothing; creator gets 55% of net ad revenue, and only inside YPP.

free_alternatives.note: Unlimited free history content, incl. OverSimplified (~10M subs). R1 cap already met.

competitor_density.note: About 39,879 history channels plus an AI sleep-history wave. R3 cap already met.

differentiation.note: No edge stated; AI narration is the commodity the wave already uses.

legal_regulatory.note: Must label realistic AI content; prompt-only output is not copyrightable, so no IP moat.

platform_dependency.note: One platform; inauthentic-content policy (2025-07) can demonetize the exact format.

market_risk.note: Automated enforcement terminated 130,000 templated AI channels; rules keep tightening.

skills.note: No stated video, scripting or history skills (user input).

assets.note: No audience, data or network (user: no special edge).

interest.note: Stated goal is side income, no stated history passion.

launch_reason: User's choice; US has the highest ad rates for English-language history content.
cheapest_test: Pitch AI-assisted script or edit samples to 30 US history channels in 7 days; stop unless 3 reply and 1 pays.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 3 replies from 30 pitches by day 7 -> stop
No paid trial by day 14 -> stop
If you run the channel anyway: under 1,000 total views on the first 8 videos by day 60 -> stop

rescue.change: Sell AI-assisted scripts or edits to established US history channels (50k-500k subs) instead of running your own channel.
rescue.why: Fixes sales_cycle, ltv_cac and platform_dependency: paid per video in weeks, no YPP gate, rides their audience.
rescue.effort: 2 weeks to first pitch; months to steady clients
rescue.requires: A portfolio of 2-3 sample edits and scripting or editing skill you may need to learn; freelance rates not researched

rescue.change: Keep the channel but make it human-led: one deeply researched niche (e.g. one US era), your own voice, AI only for visuals.
rescue.why: Eases legal_platform_risk and differentiation (inauthentic-content risk), but the 8,000 h gate and the wave remain.
rescue.requires: Narration, research and scripting skill; patience with $0 revenue for a year
